fit_reason: Whole pontoon boat listed by a private seller.
findings: Black side panels and red graphics are glossy with strong reflections on both sides
Pontoon tubes look fairly bright with no heavy staining visible at the waterline
Light scuffing and faint grime on the white vinyl of the rear lounge cushions and armrests
Some debris and leaves on the deck carpet near the stern lounge
Bimini canvas shows light dust and spotting on top
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Barletta 23UC and it looks like it has been well kept. The rear lounge vinyl has some light scuffing and the deck carpet has a bit of debris that a quick cleanup would sharpen up in photos. We do mobile pre-sale details for pontoons, including vinyl cleaning and a wash and wax on the panels and toons. Would you like a quote?
